name: pflow
description: Petri net simulation and analysis MCP server

tools.name: pflow_build
tools.description: Parse a Petri net model and return its topology: places, transitions, arcs, and initial state

tools.name: pflow_validate
tools.description: Validate a Petri net model (DSL or JSON), return structure summary and content-addressed ID (CID)

tools.name: pflow_fire
tools.description: Fire discrete transitions step-by-step on a Petri net

tools.name: pflow_simulate
tools.description: Run ODE simulation of a Petri net over time

tools.name: pflow_equilibrium
tools.description: Find the equilibrium (steady state) of a Petri net ODE system

tools.name: pflow_analyze
tools.description: Analyze Petri net structure: incidence matrix, enabled transitions
